authority: Current human asks freeze label-resolution, outcome-blind support and real-support controls, outcome join/vault closed
tier: RETROSPECTIVE IN TEXT; PROSPECTIVE IN IMAGE VARIABLE ONLY
rule: Exact A/B agreement only. Same category => that category; disagreement => UNRESOLVED. No model/rater priority, OT merge, imputation or adjudication.
gate_population: All1145 original registered physical lines remain in completed full-population G6/G2. Consensus restriction is the declared T1 analysis population, not a revised agreement population.
analysis_population: Registered nonreserved P lines with consensus image label and reading-specific source map; exclude physical source slot0 even when unknown, retain/count all other original unknown slots.
reading_scope: H and F separately. Missing reading map => explicit unavailable line, never substitute another reading.
permitted_join: Consensus image label + fixed geometry + original-slot readability/position MASK ONLY for outcome-blind support and synthetic controls. No real word-class, opener, ending, qok count or token string may enter this join.
extractor_isolation: Separate header-filtered source process has registration/EVT/tokenizer inputs but no image labels or rating files. It emits only line/locus IDs and Boolean readability masks. No real class functions called or features emitted.
support: Unchanged frozen >=30 slots per side per folio, >=8 informative folios, normalized exposure weights <=.25. Scan design support and all15 equivalence pairs reported without class counts; actual class-dependent support remains a synthetic control question.
controls: At least200 independent datasets per scenario/reading; >=10000 unrestricted within-folio whole-line label permutations per test. Recompute support on each draw. No dropped undefined draws or altered score. Synthetic rates/noise mechanisms frozen in a separate pre-control manifest after support; no empirical class rates used.
not_estimable: If observed or any null draw fails frozen support/finite-statistic rules, return NOT ESTIMABLE. Undefined controls cannot count as validated zero false positives.
classification: Label rule frozen after completed ratings but before any label/readability-mask join; no original-label freeze backdating.
budget: T1 qualification only; no alpha_V allocation/spend
